## A little math

If $x=3$, then $x^2=9$.

$$
\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{4}=\frac{3}{4}
$$

:::figure[A small illustration]{width="480" max-height="320" align="center"}

:::details[Why use a disclosure?]
Keep optional context beside the explanation.
:::

::::tabs
:::tab[The idea]
Keep **one thought** in each paragraph.
:::

:::tab[The checklist]
- Name the idea.
- Read it aloud.
:::
